purpose: Compose translation mounts, center-to-center distance joints, slack center-distance limits, world-axis translation locks, slack world-axis translation limits, fixed world-space direction locks and slack fixed world-space direction limits around one shared donor-core integration step with bounded convergence-aware pre/post stabilization.

properties.constraints.directionLocks: bounded fixed world-space direction translation-lock array
properties.constraints.directionLimits: bounded fixed world-space direction translation min/max limit array
properties.options: bounded pre/post family passes, per-family iteration counts and convergence tolerances

limitations: distance-limit, axis-limit and direction-limit range interiors remain intentionally slack
axis locks and axis limits use world-space x/y axes and are not full prismatic/slider joints
direction locks and direction limits use caller-selected fixed world-space directions, leave perpendicular translation free and do not rotate with bodies
fixed deterministic family order introduces ordering bias
conflicting constraints are bounded by pass counts and are not claimed to converge globally
the shared activity-gate and collision-isolation wrappers route all seven families; limit-edge isolation remains component-wide even while the physical interval is slack
no angular inertia, rotating local anchors, hinge, full slider/prismatic, rotational weld, motor or gear semantics
post-core projection can move bodies after donor-core contact evidence was generated

proves: the seven-family contract shares exactly one donor-core integration step
fixed-direction limits are appended after the prior six-family order without replacing earlier semantics
bounded family pass and iteration budgets include direction limits
fixed-direction limits participate in the one-step composer, guarded activity filtering and component isolation while preserving slack/perpendicular freedom

truth.basis: The composer names ordering bias, translation-only scope, slack-range semantics, contact-evidence timing, fixed-world direction semantics and component-wide isolation behavior.

agency.basis: Callers choose family data, fixed direction vectors, bounds, activity state, isolation request and convergence tolerances explicitly.

continuity.basis: Direction limits are appended after the existing six-family order while the donor source and prior family semantics remain preserved.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The integration reuses the direction-limit prepare/measure primitives inside the bounded one-step composer rather than chaining standalone step wrappers and accidentally integrating physics twice.
